source_of_truth: ouuut-v2 design-lock + live computed styles at 1440px, 2026-10-21. japan.ouuut.com must read as the same publication as ouuut.com.
style: Tokyo Expedition Magazine Editorial / ouuut family. Two themes only: sage (day) and dark (night). Zero structural lines.
theme_boot: localStorage pj-theme wins; otherwise sage 06:00-17:59, dark otherwise. No mono.

typography.serif: Instrument Serif 400 / Noto Serif JP 700 / Noto Serif SC 700
typography.sans: Geist 400-500 / Noto Sans JP 500 / Noto Sans SC 500

assertions.check: No mono theme in HTML/JS/CSS; data-theme is sage or dark
assertions.how: grep -R "mono" site src | filter allowed font-family refs

assertions.check: Computed --bg/--ink/--muted/--accent/--surface equal ouuut.com at same theme
Logo font-family Outfit, weight 800, size 33px, color accent
JA cover H1 72/700/1.3, section 44.8/700, body 17; EN cover H1 89.28/400/.96
No visible border/outline on structural elements
assertions.how: scan computed border-width/outline-width excluding focus rings

assertions.check: All declared faces loaded; every visible CJK element's first family covers its text
All sitemap pages return 200 and contain one h1
No hardcoded brand palette hex in app/*/view.js chart ramps
JS disabled: content, tables, links visible; no blank reveal states

notes: Homepage uses four prod-style plates (one per chapter: quake, crime, cabinet, housing), each plate itself a link.
Charts use one signal hue per theme; no rainbow categorical palette.
Motion: grain, scroll progress, header scrolled, .rv reveal, theme view-transition. No custom cursor/particles.
